associationModel.candidateGeneration: Within each (chunkId, temporalPassId, poseSectionId) group, observations sorted by logMonoTime then segmentId then sourceSlotIndex; active tracks matched via Hungarian assignment per time step. Cross-chunk association is intentionally forbidden — chunkId is part of the grouping key.

shapeMismatch.description: RMSE of d profile on overlapping s

timeGap.description: Elapsed time since last track observation

associationModel.normalization: Each term scaled by assessment weight; invalid gates return Infinity cost
associationModel.gating: Reject when time gap, lateral jump, heading, confidence, uncertainty, or s-overlap gates fail before cost evaluation
associationModel.tieBreaking: Hungarian minimum total cost; ambiguous when second-best cost within ambiguousCostRatio of best valid cost
associationModel.trackBirth: Unmatched observation after assignment becomes new_track unless rejected by gates
associationModel.trackContinuation: Hungarian match with cost below maxAssociationCost
associationModel.trackTermination: Track removed from active set after maxMissedFrames without match
associationModel.maxSupportedObservationGap: maxTrackGapFrames frames or maxTimeGapSec between consecutive associations

outcomeSemantics.associated: Hungarian-assigned continuation of an existing track with valid cost below threshold
outcomeSemantics.new_track: New divider-track hypothesis created; birthReason records why (not a hidden association failure)
outcomeSemantics.rejected_ambiguous: Two or more active tracks have valid local costs within ambiguousCostRatio for this observation
outcomeSemantics.rejected_no_candidate: No active tracks at assignment time and observation failed eligibility for new hypothesis
outcomeSemantics.rejected_geometry_mismatch: All active track candidates failed lateral, route-s, or shape gates
outcomeSemantics.rejected_temporal_gap: All active track candidates failed temporal gap gate
outcomeSemantics.rejected_boundary: Pass, section, or unsupported chunk boundary gate failed for all candidates
outcomeSemantics.rejected_crossing: Reserved for explicit crossing rejection policy (not used in current prototype)
outcomeSemantics.rejected_other: Cost above threshold, confidence, uncertainty, or other gate failure on all candidates
outcomeSemantics.newTrackVsRejection: Unmatched after Hungarian: if every candidate fails the same gate family → rejection; if mixed or competition → new_track with birthReason

ambiguitySemantics.description: Among all active tracks in the frame, the second-lowest valid per-observation cost divided by the lowest valid cost. This is NOT an alternative global Hungarian assignment.
ambiguitySemantics.notGlobal: A locally ambiguous cost ratio does not imply multiple global optima; global assignment is always Hungarian minimum total cost
ambiguitySemantics.tieBreaking: Hungarian algorithm with deterministic active-track ordering by trackId

chunkBoundaryBehaviour.groupingPolicy: Observations grouped by (chunkId, temporalPassId, poseSectionId); chunkId is part of the grouping key
chunkBoundaryBehaviour.resolution: Cross-chunk continuation is impossible with current grouping. Any prior chunk_boundary_continuation BEV category is relabeled boundary_separation. Rejected continuations in audit reflect gate checks if grouping policy changes.

documentation.frameGroup: All observations sharing the same (chunkId, temporalPassId, poseSectionId, logMonoTime)
documentation.comparedTracks: Tracks with at least one observation in the current frame group; ranked by mean route-d at overlapping s
documentation.routeSCorrespondence: For each track, mean d computed from projected points with s within [frameMedianS - 10m, frameMedianS + 10m]
documentation.minSharedSupport: At least 2 tracks present in both consecutive frame groups to compare ordering
documentation.missingTracks: Tracks absent in the next frame are omitted from ranking; pairwise order changes only among persisting tracks
documentation.tieTreatment: Stable sort by trackId when mean d values are equal within 0.05 m
documentation.deduplication: Pairwise inversions among persisting tracks are deduplicated by unordered track pair. Legacy index mismatches are reported separately and include support-change noise.
documentation.crossingVsNoise: Legacy index mismatches (e.g. 1,230) include track appearance/disappearance shifting positions; pairwise inversions among persisting tracks measure true order swaps
documentation.legacyIndexMetric: Per-index comparison of deduplicated track rankings; inflates when track count changes between frames

lateralOrderAudit.rejectedCrossingExplanation: No observation is assigned rejected_crossing; ordering inversions are audit-classified separately from association outcomes. Geometric intersection candidates are labeled in ordering audit only.
